note: watergrid-prof-runfirst-1122 (RUN FIRST, PREPARED, NOT RUN; measurement, no timing claim, day OK, noiseCheck false): [WaterGrid] Prof=1 (docs/100 §13), Bin state apex (tools/turbo-compat.ts). Decides the water grid G item: (1) the phase split of the ~1 s load-time G build (samples vs objects vs label vs shorelines) and (2) whether two fresh loads of one save, and two saves of one world, give the same G fingerprint. Read per job the two "water grid build" lines; docs/100 §13.3 has the decision rules. Every job relaunches (rewind off: a rewind would skip the load the probe measures).
